findings.message: The workflow says JUnit results are reported through GitHub checks, but it does not grant the test-reporter permission to write checks. On repositories with read-only default token permissions, the reporting step can fail even when the tests pass.
findings.source_evidence: The workflow uses `dorny/test-reporter@v2` with `reporter: java-junit` and discloses GitHub checks/annotations reporting, but declares no `permissions`.
findings.requested_change: Declare the minimum required `GITHUB_TOKEN` permissions for the reporter, including `checks: write`; retain `contents: read` for checkout if setting explicit permissions.

limitations: Static review cannot establish the Jenkins agent's installed JDK or other tooling, or confirm runtime behavior of the selected runner image and external actions.
